note_on_katapayadi_names: The textbook's claim is corroborated: a katapayadi-based naming scheme for the 35 soolaadi thaalas does exist historically (e.g. Dhruva's five jaathi variants are named Pika/Vati/Saka/Lara/Dhara in the Sangita Sampradaya Pradarsini tradition, whose katapayadi values 11/14/17/23/29 exactly match the computed akshara counts), but multiple independent sources confirm these coined names are NOT used in modern practice -- musicians universally refer to thaalas descriptively by jaathi + base name (e.g. 'Chatusra Jaathi Triputa Thaalam', commonly just 'Adi Thaalam'). The specific names 'Ganeshaveena' and 'Maheshaveena' cited in the K.S.D. textbook could not be independently located in any web source searched (English or Tamil), which is itself consistent with the book's own statement that these names are not in practice -- they appear to be such a niche/obscure naming reference that they are barely documented outside specialized print texts.

anga_symbol_legend.Laghu: variable count = akshara value of the jaathi (3/4/5/7/9)
